fusions.name: Scent Lunge
fusions.desc: You surge up to 6 tiles onto the target and bite for 14 damage, 10% more for each affliction on it (up to 30%), healing for 15% of the damage dealt and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Wake
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 8 damage to each and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Feeding Pass
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, 10% of the damage you deal heals you for the next 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
